texts.zh:
我们一直在[targeted_planet.GetName]上对行星本身的结构进行大量研究，以确定如何为了我们的殖民地对行星进行改善。最近的发展不幸出了岔子，毒性废料污染了大片土地，使它们完全不宜居住。

然而，我们的计算表明，这不仅是一起孤立的事件，只要这种广泛的行星研究继续下去，就可能会有更多这样的灾难发生。
texts.en:
On [targeted_planet.GetName], we have have been conducting significant research on the structure of the planet itself to see how one might improve it for our colonies. The latest developments have sadly gone awry, with toxic wastes affecting large swathes of land, leaving them completely uninhabitable.

Our calculations suggest that this is not just one isolated incident, however, and that as long as this extensive planetary research continues, more of these catastrophes are likely to happen.

label.zh: 目前我们仍将继续研究。
在查明实情前暂停研究。
label.en: Put a hold on the research until we can figure it out.

texts.zh: 我们在[targeted_planet.GetName]上的研究产生的毒性废料引起的副作用之一是那里某些原本欣欣向荣的动植物已经灭绝，这对行星上的动植物区系造成了一连串问题。或许有些出乎意料，幸好生活在[targeted_planet.GetName]的居民大都并未因此受到伤害，不过这还是让生活变得更为困难了。
texts.en: As a side effect of the toxic wastes caused by our research on [targeted_planet.GetName], it seems some of the plant and animal life that used to thrive there have gone extinct and caused a chain reaction of issues for a lot of the fauna and flora on the planet. As unexpected as it might have been, those living on [targeted_planet.GetName] have thankfully been mostly unharmed by it, though it has made life harder for them.

label.zh: 那也不算没法处理的大事儿。
label.en: Not a problem big enough that it cannot be dealt with then.

label.zh: 已经进行足够久了，停止实验。
label.en: This has gone on long enough, end the experiments.

texts.zh:
我们原本的估计不如先前希望的那般准确，在[targeted_planet.GetName]上最近的发展出的岔子比先前希望的更大。原本的毒性废料已经扩散到行星水体当中，反过来又影响了临近的陆地。

由于大片水域和土地因此不宜居住，我们的殖民地出于安全考虑不得不进行迁移。
texts.en:
Our original estimates were not as precise as we had hoped, and the latest developments on [targeted_planet.GetName] have gone further awry than we had hoped. The original toxic waste had already spread into the water on the planet, and in turn affected the nearby land.

With large tracts of water and land both left inhospitable, our colonies have been forced to move away for their own safety.

label.zh: 到这一步再回头为时已晚。
label.en: It is too late to turn around at this point.

label.zh: 亡羊补牢，该结束实验了。
label.en: Better late than never, we need to end this.

texts.zh:
我们收到报告称，岩浆从[targeted_planet.GetName]的地壳中涌出。似乎最近在行星上所做的研究使其不再稳定，以至于地震近几个月来司空见惯，人们开始对那里的科学家失去信心了。

如此来看，我们的科学家似乎确定我们如今已然触底，不论是作为比喻而言还是就字面意义来看。
texts.en:
We have received a report that molten lava has emerged from the crust on [targeted_planet.GetName]. It seems the latest research done on the planet has made it unstable enough that earthquakes have become commonplace these last months, and people have started losing faith in the scientists there.

By all accounts, it seems our scientists are certain we have hit rock bottom now, both figuratively and literally.

texts.zh:
我们在[targeted_planet.GetName]上最近所做的研究似乎对行星造成了更多副作用。在我们的一处殖民地附近发生轻微地震后，毒气和熔化的岩石从地面突然喷射而出，致使原先受到控制的局面转变成了大灾难。

鉴于在[targeted_planet.GetName]上最近发生的种种灾厄，我们计算出的估计是目前见到的已经是最坏情况了。
texts.en:
It seems the latest research we have done on [targeted_planet.GetName] has caused even more side-effects to the planet. In the aftermath of a minor earthquake near one of our colonies, molten rocks and gases suddenly surged forth from the earth, turning a situation we had under control into a catastrophe.

With all of the latest calamities happening on [targeted_planet.GetName], our calculations estimate that we have seen the worst of it by now.

label.en: At least it cannot get worse.
